name: chol
expr: R = chol(A); L = chol(A,'lower'); [~, p] = chol(A); [R2, p2] = chol(B); Rc = chol(Ac); err_c = max(max(abs(Rc'*Rc - Ac)));
comment: Sig R=chol(A) / L=chol(A,'lower') / [R,p]=chol(A). Default 'upper': R'*R=A. 'lower' returns lower-triangular L (=R') with L*L'=A. Second output p=0 when positive-definite; when not PD, p=failure column (no error) and R is the leading (p-1)x(p-1) factor. chol([1 3;3 1]) -> p2=2, R2 is 1x1 =[1]. numkit previously had NO 'lower' option and NO p output -- added. Matches MATLAB R2025b. Extended in 2026-08 for complex Hermitian matrix coverage.
